title: Cheez Its
description: Adds Cheez Its and more to Minecraft!
body:
**A mod that adds Cheez Its to Minecraft, with a survival-friendly way of getting them!**

This mod includes :

Cheez Its
Box of Cheez Its
Empty box of Cheez Its

The recipies for the items are listed below :

![Crafting recipe for the Cheez Its item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8ab71fa23fe382a2a9bbfed26452add0ddfd6c44.png)
![Crafting recipe for the Empty Box of Cheez Its item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3fd91343058eb7617f71e6cf0c2518abbd8671b0.png)
![Crafting recipe for the Box of Cheez Its item](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e76da286b1ec393a68b6162324169f22cda12a50.png)
![Crafting recipe to get the Cheez Its out of the box](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9141bf212dc8a5d0b02a618272bfb649d8708b48.png)
